status.busy: steamcmd is already running — wait for it to finish or press Cancel.
steamcmd.not_found: steamcmd not found. Set the Steamworks SDK folder in Settings.
steamcmd.not_in_sdk: steamcmd.sh not found inside {path}. Point to the “sdk” folder of the unpacked Steamworks SDK.
login.title: Steam login
login.hint: The password is only needed the first time: steamcmd remembers the login, and builds use the saved session. The password is never stored by this app or shown in the process list.
login.password_placeholder: Leave empty to use the saved login
login.logout_tip: Forget the login in this window. steamcmd keeps its saved session on disk.
login.no_saved_session: No saved login for {user} — log in with your password.
login.confirm_mobile: Confirm the login in the Steam app on your phone.
login.fail_password: Login failed: wrong username or password.
login.fail_guard: Login failed: wrong Steam Guard code.
login.fail_rate_limit: Too many login attempts. Steam has temporarily blocked logins — try again later.
login.fail_connection: Could not connect to Steam. Check your internet connection.
login.fail_no_session: The saved login has expired — log in with your password.
login.fail_generic: Login failed. Details are in the log below.
prompt.guard_text: Steam asks for a Steam Guard code (from email or the Steam app):
prompt.password_text: steamcmd asks for the account password:
build.title: Build & upload
build.description_placeholder: Shown only on the Steamworks builds page, e.g. “Alpha 0.31.0”
build.preview: Preview only — check the files, upload nothing
build.preview_tip: steamcmd scans the content and writes a manifest to the output folder, but nothing is sent to Steam.
build.set_live: After upload, set live on branch:
build.live_hint: Without this the build is uploaded but not set live on any branch — you do it on the Steamworks builds page. The “default” branch can only be set live there.
build.branch_default_warning: ⚠ Steam does not allow setting the “default” branch live from steamcmd. Choose a beta branch or set it live on the Steamworks builds page.
build.open_output_tip: Open the folder with steamcmd build logs and manifests
build.need_login: Log in to Steam first (the “Login” page).
build.confirm_preview: Preview mode: nothing will be uploaded.
build.confirm_live: After upload the build goes live on branch “{branch}”.
build.confirm_no_live: The build will not be set live — you can do it later in Steamworks.
build.script_failed: Could not write the build script: {error}
build.fail_session: ✗ steamcmd's saved login is no longer valid — log in again on the “Login” page.
depots.folder_tip: Everything inside this folder is uploaded to the depot. Double-click to choose.
depots.exclusions_tip: File masks not to upload, separated by commas: *.pdb, *_BurstDebugInformation_DoNotShip
error.app_id: App ID must be a number.
error.depot_id: Depot #{n}: depot ID must be a number.
error.branch_empty: Enter the branch name to set the build live on.
error.branch_default: The “default” branch cannot be set live from steamcmd — choose another branch or turn the option off.
error.quote: Double quotes (") are not allowed in SteamPipe scripts: {what}
profile.name: Profile name:
profile.delete_confirm: Delete profile “{name}”? Game files are not touched.
profile.import_tip: Create a profile from an existing app_build script (e.g. from ContentBuilder/scripts of the SDK)
profile.imported: Profile “{name}” imported ({depots} depot(s)). Check the folder paths.
settings.title: Settings
settings.sdk_placeholder: The “sdk” folder of the unpacked Steamworks SDK
settings.steamcmd_placeholder: steamcmd.sh or /usr/bin/steamcmd — takes priority over the SDK
settings.sdk_link: Download the SDK: partner.steamgames.com (requires a Steamworks account)
settings.check_session: Use the saved Steam login at startup
log.title: Output
quit.title: Upload in progress
quit.busy: steamcmd is still working. Stop it and quit?
